newsitem.title: USA: Bibb Cty, Ga., mulls merger with Macon, Payne City.
newsitem.headline: Bibb Cty, Ga., mulls merger with Macon, Payne City.

text.p: Georgia's Bibb County Commission has drafted a plan to consolidate the county government with those of Macon and Payne City, the Macon Telegraph said Wednesday.
The commission has not formally endorsed the plan, and will decide on Feb 11 whether to submit it to legislators for action in the General Assembly this year.
The plan would consolidate services but would keep all full-time employees of the county and the two cities.

Commission officials sid they expect the plan to win the required approval from the U.S. Justice Department because it creates five predominately black voting districts and five predominately white districts, preserving minority voting strength.
